meta.name: memory-src-tools-__tests__-knowledge-write-tools.e2e
meta.testName: Subconscious knowledge write tools against Gemini

parts.text: You are a knowledge curator. Node "node-1" is at version 3 and is named "Atlas Initiative". Rename it to "Project Atlas". Call exactly one tool.

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_append
functionDeclarations.description: Append a scoped record to an existing node. Provenance and capture time are stamped by code.

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_remove
functionDeclarations.description: Soft-delete a visible record. Curators cannot restore or physically erase knowledge records.

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_rename_node
functionDeclarations.description: Rename a visible node using optimistic concurrency.

expectedVersion.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 1

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_set_node_kind
functionDeclarations.description: Change a visible node kind using optimistic concurrency.

expectedVersion.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 1

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_merge_nodes
functionDeclarations.description: Merge a visible duplicate node into another visible node using source-version CAS.

sourceVersion.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 1

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_rescope
functionDeclarations.description: Change a record visibility scope without exceeding its stamped ceiling.

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_write_node_description
functionDeclarations.description: Write the bounded synopsis (max 400 UTF-16 code units) on an existing visible node using optimistic concurrency. Pass an empty string to clear it. Does not create nodes.

expectedVersion.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 1

description.description:
One or two plain-text sentences describing the node, targeting 40-75 tokens. Hard limit 400 UTF-16 code units, enforced by storage on every write; the length check on execution is authoritative. Long-form detail belongs in node content, not here. An empty string clears the description.
constraints: minimum length 0, maximum length 400

functionDeclarations.name: knowledge_write_node_content
functionDeclarations.description: Create or replace long-form content on a scoped knowledge node. Existing nodes require expectedVersion.

expectedVersion.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 1
